Explain AI voice tools in simple words
M
**AI voice tools** are computer programs that can listen to human speech or turn written text into realistic-sounding human voices using Artificial Intelligence. Think of them like a super-smart computer assistant that can read a story out loud, or turn your spoken words into typed text without you having to type! Here are the two main types: 1. **Text-to-Speech (TTS):** You type a sentence, and the AI reads it out loud for you in a natural-sounding voice. (Great for making videos or audiobooks!) 2. **Speech-to-Text (STT):** You speak into a microphone, and the AI writes down your words as text. (Great for taking notes hands-free!) Would you like to try using one, or learn how people use them for projects?
so can you give me some small note about microsoft word
M
Microsoft Word is a digital notebook or "word processor" that helps you create documents like letters, resumes, school reports, and flyers. Think of it as a magical typewriter where you can easily fix mistakes, change font styles and colors, add pictures, and save your work to print or share later! **Fun fact:** Since we were just talking about AI voice tools, Microsoft Word actually has a built-in **Dictate** button. You can click it, talk into your microphone, and watch Word type your words out for you automatically!
